title: How to Call a Train That Does Not Exist

shots.visual_event: Maya lays out the recall mechanism: Tick’s lost tail segment, Arin’s childhood badge, Meera’s written word MOON, and her brass handbell.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “A machine needs coordinates. A ghost train needs witnesses.”

shots.visual_event: Meera recruits twelve ordinary night workers—porter, nurse, baker, driver—each holding a mirror and agreeing to remember Platform 13.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “If it edits one of us, the others say it back.”

shots.visual_event: Inside, Arin and Saira sprint through a tilting carriage as doors relabel themselves; only Arin’s cracked badge points to Door Four.
shots.dialogue_audio: Saira: “Your sister is building a station under us.”

shots.visual_event: Tick drives the control gear on four paws while his remaining tail sparks; the sealed platform arch begins breathing steam.
Door Four and Platform 13 overlap for three seconds. Arin sees Meera at arm’s length, separated by transparent clock glass.
Arin pushes Saira’s silver compass through the glass to Meera as the overlap closes.
shots.dialogue_audio: Arin: “Find the year on that compass.”
